why: Settled with the number-like reading (Readings): a key is a path expression and always a string (L562-568), and += is the field separator (L720+). After the completed JSON number 3, or the non-number text 1e (no exponent digits), += begins — so the keys are "3" and "1e", and += onto nothing is {"3": [[]], "1e": [1]}. typesafe/config's Parse is the same lenient-number biproduct as 01→1: its tokenizer eats + as an exponent and fails; pyhocon drops the brackets. Not a separate HOCON hole.
